data.title: Telxius Boosts Global Network Capacity and Efficiency with Nokia 800G Coherent Pluggable Deployment
data.description: Telxius has significantly enhanced its global network capabilities by implementing Nokia's 800G Coherent Pluggable technology. This deployment allows Telxius to improve capacity and efficiency across its network infrastructure. The Nokia 800G Coherent Pluggable solution enables faster data transmission rates, increasing capacity by up to 800 Gigabits per second per wavelength. This advancement represents a significant milestone in Telxius' efforts to enhance its network performance and meet the growing demands of customers for high-speed connectivity services.

data.title: Naviq recognised by HFS Research as an Enterprise Innovator in travel transformation
data.description: Naviq, a specialized travel company, has been recognized by industry experts for its expertise in the sector, advanced technology, and focus on implementing artificial intelligence in enterprise transformation. The company, founded in July 2026, has quickly gained attention for its innovative approach. This recognition underscores Naviq's commitment to revolutionizing the travel industry through its unique combination of skills and cutting-edge technology.

data.title: NSFOCUS Receives Frost & Sullivan's 2026 Technology Innovation Leadership Recognition in the Chinese AI Security Industry
data.description: NSFOCUS has been recognized for its AI-native security innovation, comprehensive protection throughout the life cycle, and close alignment with the changing requirements of China's regulated businesses. The accolade was given by Frost & Sullivan on September 15, 2026 in San Antonio. This highlights NSFOCUS's commitment to meeting the security needs of enterprises in China.

data.title: Lundbeck announces last patient randomized in DEEp SEA, a Phase III trial of bexicaserin in Dravet syndrome
data.description: The DEEp SEA trial is a Phase III global study assessing the effectiveness, safety, and tolerance of the experimental drug bexicaserin in individuals with Dravet syndrome. The completion of randomization signifies a significant achievement in the global Phase III DEEp program. This trial includes participants of various ages with Dravet syndrome.

data.title: MGI Tech Launches VisiOmics in Europe and Unveils AI-Enabled Pathology Portfolio at ECP 2026
data.description: Integrated solutions for tissue and molecular pathology, ranging from multiplex immunofluorescence to sample-to-result sequencing, are now available through innovative technologies powered by AI. MGI Tech Co., Ltd. (MGI) is spearheading this development. As of September 15, 2026, MGI is introducing advanced tools to revolutionize pathology with cutting-edge techniques. The company is committed to enhancing diagnostic capabilities and improving efficiency in the medical field. This marks a significant advancement in the integration of technology into medical research and analysis, providing comprehensive solutions for better patient outcomes.

data.title: Hanshow, shopreme, and Lucky cart Unveil a New Smart Cart Solution to Enhance the Shopping Experience and Drive Retail Growth
data.description: A global leader in digital store solutions, Hanshow, unveiled today a new Smart Cart product developed in collaboration with shopreme and Lucky Cart. This innovative solution integrates AI-driven shopping aid, accurate in-store guidance, and self-checkout functionality. The launch marks a significant advancement for retail technology, catering to the increasing demand for seamless and efficient shopping experiences.

data.title: Scania G-series and R-series achieve five-star Euro NCAP results
data.description: In Södertälje, Sweden, on September 15, 2026, it was announced that Scania's G-series and R-series trucks received five stars in Euro NCAP's haulage assessment. The trucks obtained an impressive 96 percent score for crash avoidance. This achievement highlights Scania's commitment to enhancing visibility, driver assistance features, and implementing advanced driver technologies.

data.title: Momax Wins 2026 IFA Innovation Award in Berlin
data.description: Momax recently unveiled their new product, Power S.Pass² Air, which has set a remarkable standard for portable power with Semi-Solid-State Battery (SSB) technology. Launched in Hong Kong on September 15, 2026, the Power S.Pass² Air showcases exceptional craftsmanship alongside its advanced battery capabilities. Momax is known for its innovative SSB technology used in mobile power banks, and this latest release further solidifies their position as a leader in the industry.
